name: design-pack
description: SystemOfADesign: design orchestrators for people who are not designers (design-director, design-builder) plus vendored specialist skills (Stageshow).

plugins.name: design-orchestrators
plugins.description: design-director (explore / audit / redesign / route; writes .design/brief.md or audit.md, never edits product code) and design-builder (implements an approved brief in phases, runs review passes, records DESIGN.md). Both resolve 112 specialist skills through a shared catalog.

plugins.name: stageshow
plugins.description: Vendored copy of Benji Taylor's Stageshow: faux product UI illustrations and cursor demo animations in React (hero shots, feature cards, bento tiles, phone stories) with a kit, gold examples and film-based verification. Upstream: benjitaylor/skills.
